datasets.name: 96e65a6f
queryLines:
SELECT
    p.episode_id,
    a.day,
    a.phase,
    a.step_index,
    a.seat_index,
    p.player_id,
    p.model_name,
    p.role,
    p.team,
    a.action_type,
    a.target_id,
    a.message,
    a.reasoning,
    a.perceived_threat_level,
    CASE WHEN a.perceived_threat_level = 'SAFE' THEN 0
        WHEN a.perceived_threat_level = 'UNEASY' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END AS perceived_threat_level_int,
    a.prompt_tokens,
    a.completion_tokens,
    a.reported_cost
FROM silver.players p
INNER JOIN silver.actions a
ON p.episode_id = a.episode_id AND p.player_id = a.actor_id

datasets.name: f5aacb1b
queryLines:
SELECT episode_id, marker_id, marker_kind, action_id, group_id, group_order, group_label, phase_label, display_player_id, display_seat_index, player_label, actor_id, model_name, role, team, target_id, target_label, action_type, action_category, action_label, is_vote, day, phase, detailed_phase, action_round, step_index, batch_index, entry_index, created_at, outcome_type, outcome_description, grouping_status, timestamp_status, reasoning, message, perceived_threat_level, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, reported_cost, error
FROM gold.game_timeline
WHERE episode_id = try_cast(:timeline_episode AS BIGINT)

datasets.name: timeline_episodes
queryLines: SELECT CAST(episode_id AS STRING) AS episode_id FROM silver.episodes ORDER BY episode_id DESC

lines:
# Game progression

Choose one episode. Circles are actions; vote targets appear above them. Diamonds show elected targets, squares show successful saves, and red crosses show actual eliminations. Hover a marker for its full reasoning, message, and event details. Use the episode and day/night controls to narrow the detail table below. Day and night columns have different shading. Rounds follow recorded player order when available; otherwise actions retain individual step positions.
